papers.title: TriGlue: a Biology-Inspired Generative Model for Generating Molecular Glue-Induced Ternary Complex
papers.abstract: Abstract  Molecular glue degraders have emerged as a promising strategy for targeted protein degradation by inducing ternary complex formation between an E3 ubiquitin ligase and a target protein. Despite their therapeutic potential, computational design of molecular glues remains largely unexplored. Unlike conventional structure-based drug design, molecular glue design is governed by the unknown protein-protein interface and requires the simultaneous modeling of ligand generation, protein-protein docking, and ternary complex assembly. In this work, we formulate molecular glue design as a ternary complex generation problem and propose a biology-inspired generative framework, TriGlue. Motivated by the mechanism of molecular glue action, we decompose ternary complex generation into two coupled stages: interface estimation and interface-conditioned complex generation. First, we develop an SE(3)-equivariant interface estimation module that predicts a geometrically constrained protein-protein interface from unbound monomer structures. Second, we introduce an interface-conditioned ternary flow matching network that jointly generates the molecular glue and predicts the rigid-body transformation required to assemble the ternary complex. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TriGlue generates chemically valid molecules and produces plausible ternary complexes, which highlight the potential of biology-inspired generative modeling for accelerating molecular glue discovery. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuliangyan0807/molecular-glue-design.

ru.title: Генеративная модель для дизайна молекулярных деградаторов белков
ru.desc: В работе предложен TriGlue — генеративный фреймворк для computational design молекулярных клеевых деградаторов белков. Авторы формулируют задачу дизайна как проблему генерации тройного комплекса между E3 убиквитин лигазой, целевым белком и малой молекулой-лигандом. Подход разложен на два этапа: оценка интерфейса белок-белок с использованием SE(3)-эквивариантной нейросети и условная генерация тройного комплекса через flow matching сеть. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что модель генерирует химически валидные молекулы и правдоподобные структуры комплексов, демонстрируя эффективность biology-inspired генеративного моделирования.

en.title: TriGlue: Accelerating Molecular Glue Discovery through Generative Modeling
en.desc: This paper introduces TriGlue, a novel framework for designing molecular glue degraders that facilitate targeted protein degradation. The approach formulates the design process as a problem of generating ternary complexes, which involves predicting protein-protein interfaces and generating suitable ligands. TriGlue employs an SE(3)-equivariant module for interface estimation and a flow matching network for complex assembly, effectively modeling the interactions between proteins and ligands. The results show that TriGlue can create chemically valid molecules and plausible ternary complexes, showcasing its potential in accelerating the discovery of molecular glues.

zh.title: 生物启发的分子胶设计新方法
zh.desc: 分子胶降解剂是一种有前景的靶向蛋白降解策略，通过诱导E3泛素连接酶与目标蛋白形成三元复合物。尽管其治疗潜力巨大，但分子胶的计算设计仍然未被充分探索。与传统的基于结构的药物设计不同，分子胶设计需要同时建模配体生成、蛋白质-蛋白质对接和三元复合物组装。本文提出了一种生物启发的生成框架TriGlue，将分子胶设计视为三元复合物生成问题，展示了其在加速分子胶发现方面的潜力。
